target: SWE intern / new-grad roles (general software engineering, 2026–27 recruiting cycle)
seven_second_takeaway: UMD CS '28; AWS SDE intern, Capital One SWE intern, Amazon contract work; lots of AWS services and percentages; four simultaneous 'Present' roles.

score_rationale.impact_clarity: Several bullets end on tech lists (X-Ray, SNS, API Gateway) instead of an outcome; AWS bullet has no result; IEX bullets lack findings.
score_rationale.quantification: 90% satisfaction, 34% speedup, 93% satisfaction lack baseline, metric definition, or sample size; 20K visits measures the product, not the caching work.
score_rationale.technical_depth: Good design choices (precomputed index, LFU cache, LSM vs B+ tree), but Amazon contract bullets lean toward AWS service enumeration.
score_rationale.concision_readability: Nearly every bullet runs a full two lines; dense tech-stacked phrasing; header contact line wraps.
score_rationale.credibility: AWS intern in Redmond while three College Park roles read 'Present'; 'adopted into ecosystem', 'scaled', unanchored satisfaction percentages invite hard follow-ups.
score_rationale.visual_layout: Clean and one page but dense; heavy italics on titles/locations; contact line wraps awkwardly to second line.
score_rationale.domain_fit: Strong general-SWE evidence present; AWS role is the weakest-written yet top-listed entry.

must_fix: Clarify date overlaps: AWS internship in Redmond (Sep–Dec 2026) overlaps Amazon contract, UMIACS, and TerpLabs all marked 'Present'; mark paused/ended roles or change end dates honestly.
Clarify: what does '90% satisfaction vs. the old tool' measure, and how many users rated it?
Clarify: what metric improved 34% in the Kinesis/Lambda pipeline (throughput, end-to-end latency, cost)?
Clarify: what 'adopted into Leo's ecosystem' concretely means (which teams/users, internal vs production).
TerpLabs Tortuga bullet attributes 20,000+ visits to the product, not the caching work; state the caching result or decouple the two.

bullets.quote: Researching and implementing Java-based utilization optimizations for
bullets.issue: Vague and generic; 'utilization' of what? No technique or scope; reads as placeholder.
bullets.suggestion: Name the component and resource being optimized (e.g., which Redshift subsystem and whether CPU/memory/storage), keeping it explicitly in-progress.

bullets.quote: Rebuilt the legacy UI of a test-data
bullets.issue: Tech list front-loaded; '90% satisfaction' has no rater count or definition.
bullets.suggestion: Rebuilt a legacy test-data workflow builder UI (React/TypeScript/Electron) with a React-Flow editor and Jest-tested validation; 90% of [N] users preferred it over the old tool

bullets.issue: Good design decision, but no stated result; 'minimize DB queries' lacks what changed.
bullets.suggestion: Built a precomputed tree-style search index over popular workflows from a 270K+ row PostgreSQL table (Python/SQLAlchemy, Redis) to stay within DB access limits

bullets.quote: Cut workflow generation time 65% to under
bullets.issue: 'Claude skill using sub-skill decomposition' is jargon a non-LLM interviewer won't parse; clarify generation of what.
bullets.suggestion: Cut LLM workflow generation time 65% to under 15s by decomposing a Claude agent into sub-tasks with Python search/validation tools, targeting stages flagged in CloudWatch/OpenSearch latency logs

bullets.quote: Shipped an Amazon Leo space-research tool adopted
bullets.issue: 'Adopted into ecosystem' is puffy; deployment stack listed but what the tool does is missing.

bullets.quote: Sped up a pipeline routing 6,000+ scraped
bullets.issue: 34% of what metric? Tail clause 'exposed via API Gateway' adds nothing.
bullets.suggestion: Cut [latency/throughput metric] 34% for a pipeline routing 6,000+ scraped research documents to inference by moving to Kinesis streams feeding Lambda processors

bullets.quote: Automated fine-tuning of an AWS Bedrock source-relevancy
bullets.issue: Strong decision (skip redundant retraining) buried under service enumeration; no outcome stated.
bullets.suggestion: Automated Bedrock relevancy-model fine-tuning on EventBridge schedules with decision gates that skip redundant retraining runs; added X-Ray tracing and SNS failure alerts

Reduced research-environment setup time 30% with uv
